steps.message: Open the file task.html in Downloads in the file manager; when prompted open it with Chrome. Then navigate the X to the bottom-right cell, by using the direction buttons.
Execute: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/Download/task.html -t text/html -e com.android.htmlfileprovider.EXTRA_TARGET_BROWSER_PACKAGE com.android.chrome

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/Download/task.html -t text/html -e com.android.htmlfileprovider.EXTRA_TARGET_BROWSER_PACKAGE com.android.chrome"
